v37.03 shipped and is on his PC (8802 serves 37.03). Preflight and the gate passed, and the seed 4242 fingerprint held (ents 85/374, containers 165/593). The gate check runs against a fake IndexedDB, because checks are synchronous. The real browser IndexedDB path has not been exercised.

- **Copy:** every save is now also written to IndexedDB (database `pillagers-save`, store `profile`, keyed by the save key). The write happens 0.4 s after saves go quiet, and right away when the page is hidden. It is written even if localStorage is full. The key `salvagerun:profile` and the profile shape are unchanged, so there is no migration.
- **Restore:** at boot, the game reads the copy only when localStorage has no save or one that won't parse. It writes the copy back into localStorage. A save that won't parse is kept aside under `…:unreadable`, as before. Numbered saves 2 to 8 that localStorage lost are put back too.
- **Erase:** erasing a save on the title also erases its copy, so it can't come back at the next boot.
- **Persist:** `navigator.storage.persist()` is called once, after the first click, key or touch.
- **Both windows:** the player 2 window uses the same code with its own numbered save key. The gate did not exercise it in two windows, and I took no pictures, since nothing on screen changes.
